BLOCKED: Edit requires a tracked task on this thread before edits can land.

No `in_progress` task exists on this thread. `ready`-status rows don't count — `ready` is backlog, `in_progress` is the actual claim. The Work panel needs to honestly reflect what's shipping while it ships, not after.

Pick one before re-issuing the edit:
  • New concern → `mcp__oxplow__create_task` with status=in_progress, then re-run Edit. Close to done via `complete_task` when settled.
  • Fix/redo of a recently-closed done item → `mcp__oxplow__update_task` → status=in_progress on that item, then re-run Edit. Close back to done when settled.
  • Already dispatched against a ready row → `mcp__oxplow__update_task` → status=in_progress on that row first.

Do not file a placeholder "untracked work" item — describe the real change you're about to make.
